messages:
Samir (Design): quick sync — here's my draft for the Alerts > Rule list sorting and empty state copy. attaching screenshots in thread. looking for feedback on default sort and microcopy.

Olivia (Product): +1 to doing a default that surfaces active rules first. my proposal: Active → Severity desc → Name asc. also expect search to persist across navigation.

Kai (Eng): active-first is fine. severity sorting needs a stable mapping (critical > high > medium > low) — trivial to implement. small Q: do we do sort client-side or server-side for large orgs?

Samir (Design): plan: client-side for most orgs (<500 rules), server-side fallback when list size > 500. UI will show a `Sort by` dropdown with the selected sequence. quick mock: 
```
Sort by: Active → Severity ↓ → Name A–Z
```

Priya (A11y): accessibility nits: the dropdown needs `aria-label="Sort alert rules"` and we should announce order changes with an aria-live region. severity chips: current orange on pale bg is borderline for AA contrast.

Olivia (Product): empty state copy — we experimented with two tones. prefer action-forward copy that guides next step. proposed: 
```
No alert rules yet
Create your first alert to get notified when SLOs slip.
[Create alert]
```

Samir (Design): alt shorter option: 
```
No rules yet
Set up an alert to watch a service.
[Create alert]
```

Kai (Eng): both copies good. backend will accept deep link from CTA. note: button should be `primary` and not `danger`.

Priya (A11y): add alt text for the illustration: "empty alert list illustration showing an inbox with zero items". ensure the CTA has a visible focus ring and keyboard order lands on the button.

Samir (Design): also thinking about the empty state secondary action — "Import rules" — should be less prominent. maybe plain text link under the CTA.

Miro Bot: deployment:preview succeeded — preview URL: https://preview.redwood.ai/alerts/rules?variant=sort-emptycopy :tada:

Olivia (Product): +1 on active-first and the action-oriented copy. Priya — can you confirm the contrast thresholds for the new chips?

Priya (A11y): will check and post suggested color tokens by EOD Monday.

Samir (Design): I'll update the high-fi comps with the sort dropdown, new chips, aria labels, and both empty state variants. will post before EOD Monday for final QA. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
